card.name: Partway through names and web addresses
card.fires_on: Pieces in the middle or end of proper names, email and web addresses, and other odd strings. Examples are a surname after a hyphen, a site name inside a URL, or a Latin species name.

modes.label: Web addresses
modes.description: A piece of a site name or email name inside a URL or email address.

modes.label: Surnames and species names
modes.description: The end of a surname in a speaker label, or the middle of a Latin plant name.

modes.label: Symbols and numbers in references
modes.description: A digit in a scripture reference or a letter in a formula or pronunciation key.

card.plain: It fires inside unusual names and web addresses, where the next piece is hard to guess.
